subject: Food delivery market in Nepal
executive_summary: The Online Food Delivery market in Nepal contains two different delivery service solutions: Meal Delivery and Grocery Delivery. Foodmandu is Nepal's first online food delivery service, founded in 2010. The total addressable market (TAM) and market growth rate are unknown, as well as the characteristics of customers using food delivery services in Nepal and the key economic factors influencing the food delivery market in Nepal.

key_observations.text: The Online Food Delivery market contains the buyer and revenue development of two different delivery service solutions: (1) Meal Delivery and (2) Grocery Delivery.
Another model of online food business is known as cloud kitchen where a company owns the food and delivery part of the business.
